Lemma
[Map-Laplacian in local coordinates (Lemma K.11)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0358 ↗ def:chow-iv-k10-map-energy 1. appk:K.11\group Harmonic Maps

The pullback connection on $T^*\mathcal M\otimes f^*T\mathcal N$ defines $\Delta _{g,h}f=\operatorname {tr}_g(\nabla ^{g\boxtimes h}df)$. In coordinates, \[ (\Delta _{g,h}f)^\gamma =g^{ij}\left(\partial _{ij}f^\gamma - \Gamma (g)^k_{ij}\partial _kf^\gamma + (\Gamma (h)^\gamma _{\alpha \beta }\circ f)\partial _if^\alpha \partial _jf^\beta \right). \]
